Name: Dirchie Kart 2
Overview: Challenge your avatar against a host of Dirchie characters in fast and furious single or up to 4 player split screen multiplayer karting. Featuring standard cup races and a unique party mode, where the players alternately select from Race, Battle and Drag events across 5 or 10 rounds. On top of these modes are numerous modifiers and a penalty system so you can customise your experience..
